definitions.explanation: For liquid to exceed a container's capacity and flow out.

definitions.gloss: to pour out; to burst forth
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, for emotions, words, or people to come out in great quantity.

examples.japanese: {浴槽|よくそう}から{湯|ゆ}が{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Hot water overflowed from the bathtub.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}が{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}してきた。
{喜|よろこ}びが{心|こころ}から{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Joy wells up from the heart.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{溢|あふ}れる (to overflow) + {出|だ}す (to start, to come out)

TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) - the liquid or emotion overflows on its own

ASPECT ({ている}):
{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}している indicates an ongoing state of overflowing.

NUANCE:
The compound adds emphasis on the beginning or continuation of the overflowing action. Often used for emotional expressions.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {染|し}み{出|だ}す: to ooze out, to seep
- {流|なが}れ{出|だ}す: to flow out
- {噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to gush out

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {涙|なみだ}が{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}す: tears overflow
- {感情|かんじょう}が{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}す: emotions pour out
- {水|みず}が{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}す: water overflows
